create_animation_module_subclass: create a subclass of Module that overrides Initialize and Draw for custom animation behavior
toggle_visualize_module: call ToggleVisualize on a Module instance to switch its visualization state on or off
get_visualize_states: call GetVisualizeStates with a list of module types to retrieve their current visualization states
get_module_name: call GetName on a Module instance to retrieve the module's name string
initialize_animation_module: instantiate a Module subclass with a motion object and call Initialize to set it up
